sentences.en: I took advantage of a sale and bought three sweaters.
sentences.zh: 我趁打折的时候买了三件毛衣。

sentences.en: Excuse me, but may I exchange this sweater for another?
sentences.zh: 对不起，我可以换另一件毛衣吗？

sentences.en: All sweaters of this type are out of stock now.
sentences.zh: 这种款式的毛衣现在都断货了。

senses.zh: 毛衣，运动衫,出汗（过多）的人，发汗剂,榨取别人血汗的人（或工厂、公司等）adj.运动衫的,运动衫式的
